summary: front-book-1: 208 findings -- scripture 83, margin 68, wording 44, slip 6, reference 4, omission 3. All leaves 2-24 and 32-81 read on the page images; the goold field of every row was checked to occur exactly once in its .typ file. Oddities: (1) Several wording rows are probably 1648 misprints that Goold corrected for sense, and are flagged in their notes as the editor's call: fruitless/fruitful, prisoners/princes, continuance/contrivance, portion/potion, cherubims/seraphims, the people/the prophet, in us/in it, answer/answerer, tendeth/trencheth. (2) Not listed: Goold's own bracketed insertions ([chapter third.], [His promise], [tabernacle], [you make to be], [secondly,]); the 1648 margin ordinals Secondly/Thirdly/Fourthly on leaves 73 and 75 that only repeat the text (Goold took them into the text); trivial these/those and other/others swaps; Goold's corrections of wrong 1648 references. (3) The 1648 section numbering in Book I is irregular (Chap. V prints its sections as I, I, II, VI; Chap. VIII has no V), and the margin rows give it as printed. (4) Rom. iv. 25 is quoted four times in Owen's own form (he died for our sins, and rose ...) and Goold replaced each with the KJV. (5) Leaf 70 has a short margin note read as To Sange., low confidence. No leaf was unreadable, though the edges of leaves 36, 44 and 50 are faint.
